page_text: Approve award of the Michigan–Indiana State Line Remonumentation survey contract to DLZ
Michigan, Inc., the sole responding bidder, for a lump-sum amount of $126,800, subject to
resolution of proposal clarifications and final contract review.
St. Joseph County solicited proposals for professional surveying and remonumentation services
under State grant BCC MI-IN 26-104. One proposal was received, from DLZ Michigan, Inc., for
$126,800.The project covers 26 state-line mile posts, numbered 54 through 79. Services include
historical research, survey retracement, monument recovery or replacement, peer-group and
State Line Commission review support, recording of corner certificates, and final survey
documentation. Completion is required by December 31, 2027. DLZ has experience surveying
other portions of the Michigan–Indiana state line. Its proposal is $8,831 below the approved
Funding source: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Bureau of
Construction Codes, Michigan–Indiana Border Survey Grant No. 26-104.Total amended grant
DLZ contract: $126,800.Remaining survey-services allocation: $8,831.The proposed contract is
within the State-funded survey-services allocation; no additional County funding is requested.
St. Joseph County Geographic Information Systems Department
Michigan-Indiana State Line Remonumentation Project - Grant BCC MI-IN 26-104
DLZ Michigan, Inc. (DLZ) is a multi-disciplinary, consulting engineering firm and a leader
in the surveying industry with 30+ offices throughout the Midwest. DLZ has assembled a
quality professional team to survey and remonument the Michigan-Indiana State Line for St.
Joseph County (County). We are known for our experience, exceptional technical work, and
unmatched client service. DLZ’s reputation for client satisfaction is best demonstrated by
the fact that approximately 95% of our work comes from repeat clients.
With 12 licensed Indiana Professional Surveyors, 4 licensed Michigan Professional Surveyors,
and a Certified Federal Surveyor on staff, we feel that we are ideally suited for this project.
We have carefully selected team members and individuals that possess the knowledge and
experience critical to the successful completion of these surveys.
